pack: Suno + REAPER candidate packs for four factions: Black Sect, Sulgogars, Ghorkov and Taerkasten
collaboration: Coda built the REAPER lab, the v02 cuts, the Black Sect and Sulgogar production plan and the reviewed cue contract. Red generated the remaining Black Sect and Sulgogar takes, wrote, generated and selected the Ghorkov and Taerkasten packs and the Black Sect message-19 lines, verified the cuts, rendered them natively in REAPER and integrated them.
listening_status: Andrei listened to the version 4 Black Sect and Sulgogar reels on 2026-11-02 and called them good. He asked for the message-19 fix that this version makes. Nobody has heard the Ghorkov and Taerkasten files or the two new Black Sect lines yet. They are ASR-verified, and their accent is checked by a language-ID cue. Auditory, accent and in-game acceptance remain with Andrei.
level_policy: -18 LUFS routine / -17 LUFS for Sulgogar events whose duration target starts at 0.8 s, true peak <= -3.5 dBFS before export, gain capped at +12 dB (three quiet Sulgogar calls stay below target). Ghorkov and Taerkasten use the -18 LUFS target.
black_voice: Suno v6 (Songs Advanced, spoken word, male) takes separated with Demucs htdemucs vocal stems; four lines are Coda v02 cuts of her own Suno vocal estimates. Message 19 lines: Black Sect Production 08 (Suno v6, Coda's Production 01 prompt), htdemucs vocal stem.
sulg_provenance: Suno v6 creature-call takes used unseparated; three Coda v02 salvage fragments kept.
ghorkov_voice: Suno Speech (beta), male, background music off, variety off. Each script puts a short Russian radio phrase and an ellipsis paragraph before every English line; the Russian phrases are cut away and never ship. Some takes carried a low drone bed despite music off; their htdemucs vocal stems are used.
taerkasten_voice: Suno Speech (beta), male, background music off, variety off, with a short German phrase before every English line (cut away). The last batch used a plain dry-recording tone that leaves no drone bed.
accent_method: Suno ignores accent wording in the tone, so the L1 priming phrase carries the accent. The check is Whisper small language ID. Calibrated on the GMU Speech Accent Archive (2 s chunks, per-speaker medians): native English speakers P(ru) 0.0001-0.0008, Russian second-language speakers P(ru) 0.004-0.21, German second-language speakers P(de) 0.0012-0.011. It is a cue, not a measurement of how strong the accent sounds.
selection: Whisper word alignment locates each line; the cut sits at the silence around its vocal island. An edge audit transcribes and language-identifies every island in the cut and trims away priming phrases, breaths and clicks. A residue check rejects cuts with sound outside the line's words. A cut is eligible only if base.en, small.en and medium.en, transcribing it in isolation, hear exactly the planned line in at least two of three cases.

v03.method: Native REAPER 7.79 render through the TwelveTake bridge; per-cue sample windows cut by cue_export.finalize; ffmpeg pan/resample to PCM16 mono 22050 Hz.

v04.method: Native REAPER 7.79 render through the TwelveTake bridge; the bridge mailbox was driven by file transfer because the device shell was unavailable. Per-cue sample windows cut by cue_export.finalize; ffmpeg pan/resample to PCM16 mono 22050 Hz. The 30 unchanged Black Sect cues re-rendered byte-identical to v03.

previous: Version 4 (Black Sect and Sulgogars only) is in this branch history up to 09f42e7; version 3 remains on red/review-fixes.
